title: Mobile car detailing
notes: Provider-published information, not an endorsement or independent service-quality verification. Starting prices cover different scopes and vehicle sizes. Confirm final quote, address coverage and availability directly. No paid placements or partner agreements exist.

listings.name: Pearl's Auto Recon
listings.waterPowerNote: Provider says it brings water and rechargeable power. A safe parking space is required.

interiorPrice.scope: Small car or SUV; larger vehicles cost more.

fullPrice.scope: Maintenance refresh for a small car or SUV, not the deep-clean package.

listings.petHairNote: For extensive pet hair or other extreme conditions, the provider asks for a quote request first.

listings.name: Detling's Detailing
listings.waterPowerNote: Provider requests an outdoor water spigot, standard power outlet and parking space.

interiorPrice.scope: Larger vehicles and heavier messes add to the price.

listings.petHairNote: Pet hair removal is separately priced; mention pets when requesting a quote.

listings.name: 513 Auto Clean
listings.waterPowerNote: Provider brings water, power, tools and products. Customers only need to provide a place to park.

interiorPrice.scope: Basic cleanup; excludes upholstery shampoo/extraction and deep stain treatment. Estimated time: 2 hours. Larger or heavily soiled vehicles may vary.

fullPrice.scope: $340 when booked separately; $25 off automatically when booked together. Confirm vehicle size, condition, travel and add-ons.

listings.petHairNote: Pet hair removal is a $50 add-on. The quote may change after inspection for heavily embedded hair.
listings.sourceNote: Provider website and corrections supplied by Elijah Thacker of 513 Auto Clean on October 10, 2026.
listings.packageNote: Published starting prices; larger or heavily soiled vehicles may vary. Confirm the final scope and quote before booking.
listings.multiVehicleNote: Provider offers 10% off everything when booking two or more vehicles together. Confirm how discounts apply to your booking.
listings.travelNote: The first 10 minutes of drive time are free. Beyond that, the actual drive is quoted from your address before booking.
listings.serviceAreaNote: Greater Cincinnati, Northern Kentucky and Southeast Indiana. Confirm service at your address.
listings.hoursNote: Available seven days a week, 7 AM–10 PM; confirm appointment availability.
listings.guaranteeNote: Provider says that if anything is off after the appointment, it will come back and fix it. Confirm the guarantee terms directly.
listings.reviewNote: Provider reports a 5.0 rating across 32 Google reviews as of October 10, 2026. This rating has not been independently verified by JobHackAI; review counts can change.
